name: Option-O Lagom Mini (Moonshine burrs)
details: Compact single-dose electric grinder with 48 mm conical burrs; settings in dots from zero. These are the Moonshine burrs.

rangeInfo.note: Honest Coffee Guide's chart (community, not the manufacturer's): Turkish 4–22, espresso 18–38, moka pot 36–66, AeroPress 32–96, V60 40–70, filter coffee machine 30–90, French press 69–130, cold brew 80–140. Its V60 row is used for pour-over, “Filter Coffee Machine” for drip, French press for immersion.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
